newsitem.title: USA: Shell US Gulf oil/gas platform back Thurs.
newsitem.headline: Shell US Gulf oil/gas platform back Thurs.

text.p: Shell Oil Co said Tuesday it expected its Auger oil and gas platform in the U.S. Gulf of Mexico, shut this past weekend for expansion work, to be back on line by Thursday.
"It was a scheduled shutdown to put in equipment for the expansion project. It began Saturday at midnight (CST) and it should be back by (early) March 6," a company spokeswoman said.

She said production at the platform, located on Garden Banks block 426, would rise to 100,000 barrels per day (bpd) of crude oil and 300 million cubic feet per day (mmcfd) of natural gas following the upgrade.
The platform was producing 75,000 bpd of oil and 160 mmcfd of gas prior to the outage.
Shell Oil Co is the U.S.-based unit of Anglo-Dutch Royal Dutch/Shell.
